adapterExperiment.name: Midnight CyberDistill pilot 002
adapterExperiment.teacherRepresentation: Local MLX Q4R8 G128 quantized checkpoint
adapterExperiment.reviewType: Model-assisted semantic review, not independent expert certification
limitations: Laguna was not structurally pruned; storage reduction comes from an already smaller pretrained student and the chosen quantization formats.
The cases were authored and synthetic. The development and test sets each contain only 20 cases.
Label and JSON validity scores do not establish explanation, evidence, or remediation quality; targeted review found important defects.
Development cases guided checkpoint selection. Test results do not establish broad cybersecurity expertise.
Weight bytes are stored safetensors only; peak MLX allocation is not whole-process or total system memory.
Reported training elapsed time excludes the complete data preparation, teacher generation, review, and deployment workflow.
Token counts are response/supervised tokens, not the complete processed prompt-plus-answer sequence count.
Native inference parity is an engineering result, not evidence of better reasoning.
The result concerns one local recipe and does not establish that all latent methods fail.
